answer: Each epoch, scarce jetty berths are auctioned not for money but for work: every identity must submit one fresh, peer-judged service it truly completed, sealed with a private whisper nonce revealed only when the tide turns. Duplicate or near-identical submissions are discarded together, so a clone farm's copied work all sinks at once. One fake identity costs one full distinct service every epoch, and a hundred fakes cost a hundred — the price scales per identity and cannot be pooled.
